# Eleventy services

Longer-running helpers that don't fit as filters or shortcodes.

## What's here

- `NavigationBuilder.js`: builds the navigation tree from the page folders and CMS data
- `TailwindLogger.js`: prints Tailwind build stats while you work

## How it connects

- The navigation collections call `NavigationBuilder`.
- The CSS build script uses `TailwindLogger`.
